english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Hong Kong Cantonese word for a garage used to keep a car and other items.

exampleSentences.english: I parked the car in the garage, and there are tools stored inside too.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我將架車停咗喺車房，入面仲擺住啲工具。
